# 16｜Lesson 16：The Modern City

> 📌 **《新概念英语四 · 双语精讲》系列 · 第 16 篇 / 共 48 篇**
> 📖 Lesson 16 · 14 句 · 15 词 · 2 个语法点 · 6 道自测题

## 01 课文精读 · Text

**1. In the organization of industrial life the influence of the factory upon the physiological and mental state of the workers has been completely neglected.**

在工业生活的组织中，工厂对工人生理和心理状态的影响已被完全忽视。

**2. Modern industry is based on the conception of the maximum production at lowest cost,**

现代工业建立在以最低成本实现最大产量的概念上，

**3. in order that an individual or a group of individuals may earn as much money as possible.**

以便个人或群体能够尽可能多地赚钱。

**4. It has expanded without any idea of the true nature of the human beings who run the machines,**

它的扩张，完全没有考虑到操作机器的人类的真实本性，

**5. and without giving any consideration to the effects produced on the individuals and on their descendants by the artificial mode of existence imposed by the factory.**

也完全没有考虑到工厂强加的人工生存模式对个体及其后代产生的影响。

**6. The great cities have been built with no regard for us.**

那些大城市的建设完全没有考虑到我们。

**7. The shape and dimensions of the skyscrapers depend entirely on the necessity of obtaining the maximum income per square foot of ground,**

摩天大楼的形状和尺寸完全取决于每平方英尺土地获取最大收入的需要，

**8. and of offering to the tenants offices and apartments that please them.**

以及向租户提供令他们满意的办公室和公寓。

**9. This caused the construction of gigantic buildings where too large masses of human beings are crowded together.**

这导致了巨型建筑的建造，大量人类被拥挤在一起。

**10. Civilized men like such a way of living.**

文明人喜欢这样的生活方式。

**11. While they enjoy the comfort and banal luxury of their dwelling, they do not realize that they are deprived of the necessities of life.**

当他们享受着住所的舒适和平庸的奢华时，却没有意识到他们被剥夺了生活必需品。

**12. The modern city consists of monstrous edifices and of dark, narrow streets full of petrol fumes and toxic gases,**

现代城市由怪诞的建筑和充满汽油烟雾和有毒气体的黑暗狭窄街道组成，

**13. torn by the noise of the taxicabs, lorries and buses, and thronged ceaselessly by great crowds.**

被出租车、卡车和公共汽车的噪音撕裂，并不断被大量人群挤满。

**14. Obviously, it has not been planned for the good of its inhabitants.**

显然，它的规划并非为了居民的福祉。

## 03 语法精讲 · Grammar

**1. 并列状语成分的使用**

`主语 + 谓语 + 状语1 + and + 状语2`

在句子中可以使用多个并列的介词短语、分词短语等作状语，共同修饰谓语动词，说明动作发生的背景、伴随情况等，通常用and连接最后两个并列成分

用于丰富句子信息，从多个角度描述动作的相关条件、伴随状态或补充说明，避免拆分多个短句导致表达零散

**例句：It has expanded without any idea of the true nature of the human beings who run the machines, and without giving any consideration to the effects produced on the individuals.**

它（工业）在扩张时完全不了解操作机器的人的本质，也完全不考虑对个人造成的影响。

**2. while引导的让步状语从句**

`While + 从句（陈述事实）, 主句（转折内容）`

while除了引导时间状语从句表示“当……的时候”，还可以引导让步状语从句，意为“虽然，尽管”，通常放在句首，主句说明与从句内容相反的事实

用于对比两种相反的情况，突出主句内容的不合理性或出人意料，语气较although更温和，多用于书面语

**例句：While they enjoy the comfort and banal luxury of their dwelling, they do not realize that they are deprived of the necessities of life.**

虽然他们享受着住所的舒适和平庸的奢华，却没有意识到自己被剥夺了生活的必需品。

## 04 句型模仿 · Patterns

- **In the organization of ... the influence of ... upon ... has been completely neglected.**
  - 课文原句：In the organization of industrial life the influence of the factory upon the physiological and mental state of the workers has been completely neglected.（在工业生活的组织中，工厂对工人生理和精神状态的影响被完全忽视了。）
  - 仿写：In the design of online courses the influence of long screen time upon the physical health of teenagers has been completely neglected.（在网课的设计中，长时间看屏幕对青少年身体健康的影响被完全忽视了。）
- **... depend entirely on the necessity of ... and of ...**
  - 课文原句：The shape and dimensions of the skyscrapers depend entirely on the necessity of obtaining the maximum income per square foot of ground, and of offering to the tenants offices and apartments that please them.（摩天大楼的形状和规模完全取决于两个需求：一是获取每平方英尺土地的最高收益，二是向租户提供令他们满意的办公室和公寓。）
  - 仿写：The content and length of the training course depend entirely on the necessity of improving employees' work skills, and of helping them adapt to the new business system.（培训课程的内容和时长完全取决于两个需求：一是提升员工的工作技能，二是帮助他们适应新的业务系统。）
- **Obviously, it has not been planned for the good of ...**
  - 课文原句：Obviously, it has not been planned for the good of its inhabitants.（显然，它（现代城市）的规划并不是为了居民的利益。）
  - 仿写：Obviously, the new traffic rule has not been implemented for the good of ordinary commuters.（显然，这项新的交通规则的实施并不是为了普通通勤者的利益。）
